name: ESO 376-16 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 376-16, a small galaxy that may be a late-type spiral or a dwarf irregular, seen by Hubble.
label: eso376016-hubble
story: Astronomers still debate what kind of galaxy ESO 376-16 is, its shape too ill-defined to settle the question. Hubble gauged its distance from the brightness of its red giant stars, helping chart galaxies across the nearby cosmos.

claims.text: ESO 376-16 is thought to be either a late-type spiral or a dwarf irregular; its morphology is debated
Hubble gauged its distance from bright red-giant-branch stars to map nearby galaxies in 3D
ESO 376-G016 = HIPASS J1043-37, a dwarf irregular galaxy
